## Plan

Home: `hh-lab` (the Lab's instrument crate — the assembly service is C1
Lab-facing orchestration; `hh-assembly` stays the C0 kernel). The service
is semantics-free: it desugars an `AssemblySource` into an ordinary
`hir/1` document and calls the kernel's `compose → resolve →
validate_assembly → seal` verbatim (S-2/S-3).

**Source grammar** (owned decision — ADR pending; the §6.1 table lists the
authoring-sugar members; the document body rides the pre-existing `hir/1`
node/edge codecs, CC7):

```
AssemblySource = {
  dialect: "hir/1",
  root_kind: "native" | "hosted",
  document?: { root: <semantic_id>, nodes: [{kind, semantic_id?, record,
               surface?, ext?}], edges: [<edge>] },
  base?: <DefinitionRef — "ns/name[@label]" | "version:<vid>">,   // D1
  layers?: [{provenance: LayerProvenance, fragment: <partial
             assembly-section JSON>}],
  overrides?: [<ADR-0025 override spellings>],                    // D2
  imports?: [{path_or_ref, as: "ContextItem"|"Procedure"|"Text",
              content?, name?, frontmatter_schema?}],             // D3
  hosted?: {executor{harness, model?, auth?}, tools?, instructions?,
            policies?, budget?, permissions?, params?, values?},  // D5
  ext?: {}
}
```

- **D1** `base` resolves (snapshot-confined registry `resolve`) to a
  `sealed_definition` record → contributes the document scaffold when
  `document` is absent (nodes/edges/root) plus its *assembly section* as
  the lowest-precedence `packaged-default` layer (`id =
  base.version_id`). `document` present + `base` present: document wins
  the scaffold; base still contributes its layer.
- **D2** `overrides` → exactly one `experiment` layer, `id =
  H(idp ∥ "override-layer" ∥ canonical(spellings))`, precedence above all
  authored layers. Implemented as a delta fragment computed against
  `compose(lower layers)`; deletions (`~path`) carry a desugar-internal
  tombstone member stripped before `resolve` (never reaches the sealed
  form — A-2).
- **D3** `imports` → document `ContextItem`/`Procedure` nodes whose `Text`
  leaves carry `authority = external, origin = import` + `entities[]`
  `Ref`s so `$entity:` resolves. `path_or_ref` is in-file `content` at C0
  (no IO in a pure desugar — the caller supplies bytes).
- **D4** selectors/`deny:`/`head` are legal only inside layer fragments
  (the assembly section) and the designated source members (`base`,
  `hosted.executor.harness`); a `document` node carrying registry-facing
  selectors (`native.slots` non-empty) is a desugar diagnostic — slot
  selection happens only through layers.
- **D5** `root_kind = hosted` synthesizes `AgentProcess{hosted:
  OpaqueProcess{…}}` from `hosted{}`: `executor.harness` →
  `participant_ref` name selector (pinned at `resolve` against
  `participant` records); `tools`/`instructions`/`policies`/`budget`/
  `permissions` become document nodes wired into `supplies`/`budget`/
  `permissions`. `slots`/`profile_binding` in a hosted source →
  `C-CLASS-6`.

**Service** (`hh-lab::assembly::service`, pure over a `RegistryStore`
borrow + `ClassCatalog`): `assemble(source, snapshot, mode)` →
`AssemblyResult{status, sealed?, identity?, report, plan, snapshot,
derivation_key}`; `plan` adds `AssemblyDiff` vs base/lineage head +
drift (`C-REF-6`) + `defaulted_paths`/`authored_paths`/`layer_map`;
`apply` = `assemble(seal)` + `register(SealedDefinition)` + `publish`
(S-5 refuse-on-error, S-6 widening gate forwarded from the registry,
S-7 record set); `validate_batch` over `[AssemblySource |
SealedDefinition]` deduped by `derivation_key`; `explain` answers "who
set it" from the sealed doc's `layers[]` + per-key attribution
re-derived by replaying the recorded layer stack over the composed
members (`constraints` carry `source`; `slots`/`values` winners are
recomputed by precedence order — deterministic); `compile` is a
pass-through to `hh_compiler::compile` (plan-time `lcd_report`/
`opacity_report`); `diff`/`identity` are kernel operations exposed
unchanged.

**AssemblyDiff** = `project(HirDiff)`: every `DiffOp` buckets into the
14-spec set (`slot_rebind`, `slot_toggle`, `slot_param_change`,
`value_change`, `space_change`, `entity_add`, `entity_remove`,
`entity_change`, `edge_change`, `cap_change`, `profile_constraint_change`,
`surface_only`, `ext_only`, `provenance_only`) keyed by assembly path;
`flatten` returns the ops verbatim (T-1: multiset equality with
`d.ops`). Terraform-class render (`+`, `-`, `~`, `-/+`, `≈`, `·`).

**Drift** (`C-REF-6`): `plan` re-resolves the source under `snap_new`
when the caller names a different snapshot than the definition's
recorded one — `drift = project(diff(res_old, res_new))`, severity by
`sameness` (L1 info / L2 warning / L3 error); `freeze` is the only
default; `adopt` is an explicit `apply` carrying
`derived-from{hypothesis: "snapshot adoption"}` and refuses
`origin = evolution` on L3.

**Boundary**: `hh-embed` gains `assembly_ops.rs` — `lab.assembly.*`
Group L dispatch, canonical `Json` in/out (records-in/records-out),
ops table flips to implemented; conformance suite exercises the stdio
binding (AC-10).

**Corpus**: `hh-lab::assembly::corpus` — a deterministic generator of
≥100 authored sources covering every D1–D5 production (native+hosted),
the one-fixture-per-code invalid corpus, and a fuzzed-valid mutation
corpus (no `C-INT-1`).

**Stage-0 anchor**: the mini-SWE-class reference authored as a source —
`base` = a published base definition (registered fixture) + one
`experiment` layer; assembles clean, publishes under `hh/`, compiles
under both `minimal_profiles()`, `plan.exit = no_changes` vs own head.

## Gap table

| check | verdict | note |
|---|---|---|
| CC1 (single canonical form) | PASS | source codec + `hh.lab/assembly` ext use the one `Json`/canonical machinery; no second encoding |
| CC2 (authority derived) | PASS | service never mints authority — `registrar` is caller-supplied for apply/adopt only; the kernel's `kernel_prov` stamps reads |
| CC3 (determinism) | PASS | `resolved_at` is the only wall-clock input and it enters provenance/identity honestly; corpus generator + tests are seed-free |
| CC4 (no tool names in contracts) | PASS | no toolchain names added to schemas/records |
| CC5 (typed refusals) | PASS | every boundary failure is `EmbedError`/`Diagnostic` with code+path; `point_refused` is the M-1 predicate |
| CC6 (append-only ledgers) | PASS | service holds no state beyond the registry borrow |
| CC7 (one codec / one home) | PASS | `hir/1` nodes/edges decode through `hh_hir`; layer provenance through `hh_assembly::grammar` (exported for reuse, not duplicated) |
| CC8 (additive drift) | PASS | ops-table flips declare the ops already registered; schema regenerated, drift check green |
| CC9 (kernel owns semantics) | PASS | `assemble` calls `compose → resolve → validate_assembly → seal` verbatim; `compile` is a pass-through; `s3_byte_identity_with_kernel` proves S-3 |
| CC10 (no pre-decided seams) | PASS | `lab.assembly.compile` stays `stage_pending` → DF-S3.5-1 rather than a guessed codec |
| AC-10 oracle nuance | NOTED | sealed outputs carry `resolved_at`/`verified_at`, so cross-process byte-equality of whole responses is not a valid oracle; the conformance test compares stable contract fields + per-call binding (ADR-0282 D8) |
| `definition diff`/`identity` operands | NOTED | moved from file operands to sealed `version_id`s (T-2) — an observable CLI contract change vs the S3.1 placeholders |

## Evidence report

AC-R-2.10.1-{1…11} all have executable coverage (see the AC ↔ evidence
map). The service is semantics-free: sealed outputs are byte-identical
to the kernel for equivalent inputs (S-3 test), no new sealable
semantics were introduced (D4/A-2 enforced at desugar), references are
pinned only by the kernel resolver, and authored files are never
mutated (the source is decoded, desugared in memory, and sealed through
the kernel). Remaining honest gaps: `lab.assembly.compile` wire op
(DF-S3.5-1).
